response: Ward K/E (Andheri East, Vile Parle East, Jogeshwari East) has billed INR 8,264,048 of its INR 9,100,000 monsoon road repair budget, or 90.8 percent, across 165 jobs. Of these, 23.6 percent were reopened within 30 days and 61.2 percent met their service deadline. This is a low lying ward (index 0.65) where flooding is common, and the city saw 18 days of heavy or worse rain, which can explain some repeat damage. INR 303,578 was billed on roads under DLP, meaning the road is still under the original contractor's warranty, so repairs should cost the city nothing; this needs review. Four jobs were priced more than 30 percent above the rate card and should be checked. The top contractor by spend is Konkan Roadcon Pvt Ltd (synthetic). Sample work orders include WO25-00600 and WO25-00666. Ask the ward office whether contractors were asked to fix DLP roads free.
